repos.approvalNote: `main` requires approval after the last push from someone other than me
repos.stopAlso: a plan destroys, replaces, or changes a resource the PR did not mean to touch

steps.text: Read every plan on the head commit (Staging, Prod, BetterStack, PostHog) and check that each changes only what the PR intends.

Keep the branch *current*: free of conflicts with `main` (or its stack parent), and not behind it right before merging, so the plans run against current `main`. Update with `gh pr update-branch` or by merging `origin/main` into the branch and pushing. Resolve mechanical conflicts yourself, then read the new plans again.

Merging applies Terraform: the Apply workflow for each touched environment runs on merge with no manual gate. After the merge, wait for the apply runs and report each result. They run on the PR's head commit, not the merge commit, so `gh run list --branch <PR branch>` finds them. If one fails, report it and stop there; leave reruns and local applies to me.

post.leave: `terraform apply`, workflow dispatches, and console changes
post.then: , such as a local plan and apply of `environments/github`, which has no CI apply
